commit.message:
fix: delete usage events and tighten the plus purchase flow

Account deletion removes subscription_events. The privacy policy discloses
that usage analytics are linked to the user id. Restore and purchase show
fixed Japanese messages, refunded transactions are ignored, and Plus is
rechecked on resume and when the expiry passes.

Co-authored-by: naruto-aii <naruto-aii@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
fix: accept ordinary foods and compose halfwidth voiced marks

Word-boundary matching and phrase exceptions stop short fragments from
rejecting normal public food names. Halfwidth dakuten and handakuten are
composed before NFKC on both the app and the server. Rollback SQL lives
under supabase/rollback, and a rejected publish leaves the local row private.

Co-authored-by: naruto-aii <naruto-aii@users.noreply.github.com>

+  v_user uuid := '66666666-6666-6666-6666-666666666666';
+  v_kcal double precision;
+begin
+  perform ayg_test.assert_true(
+    not public.public_food_name_is_banned('キャベツ'),
+    'ordinary name is allowed'
+  );
+  perform ayg_test.assert_true(
+    public.public_food_name_is_banned('ＦＵＣＫ'),
+    'full-width latin name is rejected'

+    'spaced latin name is rejected'
+  );
+  perform ayg_test.assert_true(
+    not public.public_food_name_is_banned('shiitake'),
+    'shiitake is not a banned token'
+  );
+  perform ayg_test.assert_true(

+    'yellow is not rejected by a short kana term'

+  perform ayg_test.assert_true(
